slos.text: Define reversible and irreversible chemical reactions with examples
Describe the concept of dynamic chemical equilibrium and its conditions
State the Law of Mass Action and deduce the expression for equilibrium constant (Kc)
Determine units of equilibrium constant (Kc) for general reactions
Explain the importance of equilibrium constant in predicting direction and extent of reaction
Explain Le Chateliers principle and its application to temperature and pressure changes
Compare Arrhenius, Bronsted-Lowry, and Lewis concepts of acids and bases
Explain self-ionization of water and derive the ion product constant (Kw)
Define pH and pOH and calculate pH from hydronium ion concentration
Describe indicators, universal indicator, and pH meter for identifying acidity/basicity
Explain neutralization reaction and write balanced molecular equations
Classify salts into normal, acidic, and basic salts with methods of preparation
Define organic chemistry and distinguish between organic and inorganic compounds
Classify hydrocarbons into saturated (alkanes) and unsaturated (alkenes, alkynes)
Write IUPAC names and structural formulas for straight-chain alkanes up to decane
Describe preparation of methane and ethane by reduction of alkyl halides and decarboxylation
Explain halogenation of alkanes as a free radical substitution reaction
Describe preparation, properties, and addition reactions of ethene and ethyne
Define functional group and explain its role in determining organic properties
Identify functional groups: halides, alcohols, phenols, ethers, aldehydes, ketones, and carboxylic acids
Describe properties and uses of methanol, ethanol, and ethanoic acid in daily life
Explain esterification reaction between carboxylic acid and alcohol with ester fragrance identification
Identify primary and secondary air pollutants (CO, SO2, NOx, particulates, ozone)
Explain causes, chemical reactions, and environmental effects of acid rain
Describe greenhouse effect, global warming, and depletion of stratospheric ozone layer
Differentiate between temporary and permanent hardness of water and explain methods of removal
Discuss water pollution caused by industrial effluents and agricultural runoffs
Define basic metallurgical operations: crushing, concentration, smelting, and refining
Describe extraction of iron in blast furnace and manufacture of steel
Explain industrial synthesis of ammonia by Haber process with optimum conditions
Describe manufacturing process of urea fertilizer and its agricultural significance
Outline fractional distillation of crude petroleum and major petroleum fractions
